verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a purchase-consent gate. complete_checkout may only be called once the buyer has reviewed and confirmed the order and a payment credential has been collected. Checkouts can also escalate to requires_buyer_review, handing off to the merchant's continue_url, and only Token-tier agents granted purchase permission can complete purchases. The UCP/AP2 spec adds signed payment mandates tied to cart state. Missing for 10: evidence that Shopify itself enforces buyer confirmation rather than leaving it to the agent as a documented precondition; confirmation that Shopify implements AP2 signed mandates (shown only at UCP spec level); hands-on verification of the checkout or payment approval gate, since the probe stopped at cart creation with no checkout and no payment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, sensitive agent spending requires my documented approval — a confirmation step, signed mandate, or per-purchase consent — before money moves
